Throughout September, Natural Grocers® will raise funds for Rodale Institute. Customers can help support the next generation of regenerative organic farmers through in-store giving opportunities.


Customers can help support Rodale Institute's Farmer Training and Veteran Farmer Training programs while enjoying special savings, education and Organic Month events


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Aug. 27, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- This Organic Month, Natural Grocers® is inviting customers to join a movement that extends far beyond the grocery aisle. Throughout September, the family-operated organic and natural retailer will raise funds for Rodale Institute's Farmer Training and Veteran Farmer Training programs. This[ongoing partnership](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=3493698531&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Frodale-institute&a=ongoing+partnership) with[Rodale Institute](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=3230268788&u=https%3A%2F%2Frodaleinstitute.org%2F&a=Rodale+Institute) helps equip future regenerative organic farmers with the skills needed to grow healthy food, restore soil health and strengthen local communities.


Natural Grocers aims to raise $100,000 for Rodale Institute by September 30 with in-store fundraising opportunities.


Throughout September, customers can help support the next generation of regenerative organic farmers through in-store giving opportunities while enjoying special savings for {N}power® members, educational resources, recipes and[Organic Month](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=1367675699&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Forganic-month%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnational-event-EMA-organic-month-deals-2026&a=Organic+Month) events designed to make organic living more accessible.


**RODALE INSTITUTE FUNDRAISER** Natural Grocers aims to raise $100,000 by September 30 with the following in-store fundraising opportunities:


- Customers will have the opportunity to make contributions to Rodale Institute ($1, $5 or $10) at checkout at Natural Grocers locations nationwide.
- Natural Grocers will donate $1.00 to Rodale Institute for every limited-edition Organic Month reusable shopping bag sold (retail price $1.99).
- For every Ladybug Zip Pouch sold (retail price $2.99), Natural Grocers will donate $2 to Rodale Institute.


**NATURAL GROCERS' ORGANIC ROOTS** For more than 70 years, Natural Grocers has championed organic agriculture and provided communities with access to high-quality organic and natural products. All Natural Grocers stores are Certified Organic Food Handlers and are inspected annually by an organic certifying agency to ensure they only use national organic program-approved processes and cleaning products.


"Organic agriculture has the power to improve the health of our food, our communities and the planet, but its future depends on the farmers who carry that work forward," said Raquel Isely, vice president of marketing at Natural Grocers. "That's why we're proud to support Rodale Institute and its Farmer Training and Veteran Farmer Training programs. Through education, mentorship and hands-on experience, these programs help equip farmers with the tools they need to succeed and strengthen the regenerative organic movement. Organic Month gives us an opportunity to celebrate that work and invite our customers to invest in the next generation of regenerative organic farmers."


**RODALE INSTITUTE** Founded in 1947, Rodale Institute is a nonprofit dedicated to growing the regenerative organic agriculture movement through research, farmer training and education. Its Farmer Training and Veteran Farmer Training programs provide[farmer trainees](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=1015878201&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3D_4BIR-QniIY&a=farmer+trainees) with hands-on education and instruction designed to support successful regenerative organic operations and strengthen local food systems.


"Healthy soil is the foundation of a resilient food system, and the support of Natural Grocers advances our goal to catalyze the transition of 10 million acres of farmland to organic and regenerative organic agriculture by 2030," said Rodale Institute CEO Jeff Tkach. "Farmers are at the heart of the organic movement, and we are proud to celebrate their hard work and dedication during Organic Month alongside Natural Grocers and its customers."


**GO ORGANIC WITH NATURAL GROCERS** Natural Grocers offers {N}power® members Even More AffordableSM savings from Sept. 4–26 on products that reflect the company's commitment to organic practices.\[i\] Additional savings and perks will be offered to {N}power members from[Sept. 17–19](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=4193641218&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Forganic-month%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnational-event-EMA-organic-month-deals-2026&a=Sept.+17%E2%80%9319) .\[ii\] Special offers include discounts of up to 50% off select products,* freebies** and a "Spend & Win" opportunity.***


Through Sept. 30, Natural Grocers will also offer free Organic Month education:


- Sign up for a free[Nutritional Education Class](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=2979762080&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fevent-finder&a=Nutritional+Education+Class) at a select Natural Grocers store near you and discover how organics can nourish the body and help protect the environment.
- [Organic Month Facts from Natural Grocers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=3078895165&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Forganic-month-facts%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dedu-sustain-organic-month-2026&a=Organic+Month+Facts+from+Natural+Grocers) : Learn more about organics and why Natural Grocers believes supporting organic is better for human health, the environment and the economy.

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE**
Founded in 1955,[Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=2060284033&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4722502-1%26h%3D983952992%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestors.naturalgrocers.com%252F%26a%3DNatural%2BGrocers%2Bby%2BVitamin%2BCottage%252C%2BInc.&a=Natural+Grocers+by+Vitamin+Cottage%2C+Inc.) (NYSE: NGVC) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=4084578927&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4722502-1%26h%3D2234490073%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%252Four-five-founding-principles%26a%3DFive%2BFounding%2BPrinciples&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 174 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758744-1&h=1372956498&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4722502-1%26h%3D2605074004%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%252F%26a%3Dnaturalgrocers.com&a=naturalgrocers.com) for more information and store locations.


**ABOUT RODALE INSTITUTE**
Rodale Institute is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to growing the regenerative organic agriculture movement through rigorous research, farmer training, and education. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2025, the Institute's groundbreaking science and direct farmer support programs serve as a catalyst for change in farming and food production worldwide. Over its nearly 80-year history, Rodale Institute has proven that organic farming is not only viable but essential to humanity's survival.
